comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. Ratings and lifts checked on 2026-10-21 against the resort's 2026 Snow Valley trail map (bigbearmountainresort.com, read at full resolution), which shows chairs 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12 and 13; ratings follow the map, also where OpenStreetMap rates a run harder (The Face, and the freeride tags of the beginner slope and The Edge). Chair 2 is drawn there as a short lift beside Chair 6 at the base; OpenStreetMap's Chair 2 runs 1.1 km to mid-mountain and is hidden until it is redrawn. The hidden lifts' stations that lie within 100 m of a drawn lift (Chair 2's two, Chair 10's two) go with them by the station rule (normalize_osm.py, since 2026-11-17; overrides hid them before, review of 2026-10-22), so no station circle is drawn without its lift.

overrides.reason: Chair 4 is not on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map (chairs 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13); OSM's own fixme asks whether it is still there.
Chair 10 is not on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM's fixme says it looks merged with Chair 9.
Unnamed chair west of the ski-area polygon (694 m) that the 2026 Snow Valley trail map does not show: a removed lift.

Chair 2 on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map is a short lift beside Chair 6 at the base: its top is a little above Chair 6's, level with the Deer Meadow Grill at the foot of Lake Run, and it is drawn about a quarter as long as the Snow Valley Express. This old TIGER-import way runs 1,101 m (78% of the Express) to a mid-mountain top that the map does not have, where Race Peak, Quickie and Surprise Run start, and shares Chair 6's line for its first 370 m. An override cannot shorten a way, so it is hidden until OpenStreetMap is fixed. The expect check reads tags only: tiger:cfcc is in expect so that a redraw that drops the TIGER tags stops the build, but a geometry-only fix will not, so remove this entry by hand once the way is redrawn (its two stations go with it by the station rule while it is hidden).
Chair 1 is the Snow Valley Express on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map (the six-seat chair; OSM already has six seats).
Chair 12 is the Coyote Creek Chair on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map.
The Face is a single black diamond on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM rates it expert.
The Ladder is a double black diamond on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM rates it advanced.
Little Bowl is a single black diamond on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM rates it intermediate.
Pipeline is a single black diamond on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM rates it intermediate.
Mambo Alley is blue (a blue square) on the 2026 Snow Valley trail map; OSM rates this part easy, the rest intermediate.

The beginner slope at the base beside Chair 6, tagged freeride (it would draw as double black, ungroomed). the 2026 Snow Valley trail map shows only green terrain there (Thunder Mountain) and has no run called 'bunny slope', a description rather than a name, so the name is hidden.
The Edge, a terrain park tagged freeride, would draw dashed as ungroomed; the 2026 Snow Valley trail map shows it as a blue run (blue square) with the freestyle-terrain symbol. It stays a park.
